lines.text: Pashhur the priest, son of Immer, heard Jeremiah prophesying and had him beaten and put in the stocks.
The stocks were at the Upper Gate of Ephraim, which was by the house of the LORD.
The next day Pashhur released Jeremiah, who said the LORD calls him Magor-missabib, not Pashhur.
The LORD said He would hand Judah over to the king of Assyria, who would carry them away.
Pashhur and all who live in his house will go into captivity, and he will die and be buried there.
